character_media_caption_check.name: character_media_caption_check
character_media_caption_check.value: "character_media"."caption" IS NULL OR length(trim("character_media"."caption")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500

character_media_detach_shape_check.name: character_media_detach_shape_check
character_media_detach_shape_check.value: ("character_media"."detached_at" IS NULL AND "character_media"."detached_by_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("character_media"."detached_at" IS NOT NULL AND "character_media"."detached_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

characters_lifecycle_shape_check.name: characters_lifecycle_shape_check
characters_lifecycle_shape_check.value: ("characters"."lifecycle" = 'ACTIVE' AND "characters"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "characters"."archived_by_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("characters"."lifecycle" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "characters"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "characters"."archived_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

chat_attachment_uploads_dimensions_check.name: chat_attachment_uploads_dimensions_check
chat_attachment_uploads_dimensions_check.value: ("chat_attachment_uploads"."width" IS NULL OR "chat_attachment_uploads"."width" > 0) AND ("chat_attachment_uploads"."height" IS NULL OR "chat_attachment_uploads"."height" > 0)

chat_messages_sticker_shape_check.name: chat_messages_sticker_shape_check
chat_messages_sticker_shape_check.value: ("chat_messages"."sticker_id" IS NULL AND "chat_messages"."sticker_presentation" IS NULL) OR ("chat_messages"."sticker_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_messages"."sticker_presentation" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_messages"."kind" = 'TEXT' AND "chat_messages"."dice" IS NULL)

chat_messages_player_request_shape_check.name: chat_messages_player_request_shape_check
chat_messages_player_request_shape_check.value: "chat_messages"."player_request_id" IS NULL OR ("chat_messages"."kind" = 'SYSTEM' AND "chat_messages"."body" = '' AND "chat_messages"."dice" IS NULL AND "chat_messages"."system_data" IS NULL AND "chat_messages"."sticker_id" IS NULL AND "chat_messages"."sticker_presentation" IS NULL)

chat_messages_sticker_presentation_check.name: chat_messages_sticker_presentation_check
chat_messages_sticker_presentation_check.value: CASE WHEN "chat_messages"."sticker_presentation" IS NULL THEN true WHEN jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation") <> 'object' THEN false ELSE coalesce("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation" - 'name' - 'altText' - 'assetUrl' - 'width' - 'height' = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->'name') = 'string' AND length(trim("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->>'name')) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->'altText') = 'string' AND length(trim("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->>'altText')) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->'assetUrl') = 'string' AND length("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->>'assetUrl') BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->'width') = 'number' AND ("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->>'width')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND jsonb_typeof("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->'height') = 'number' AND ("chat_messages"."sticker_presentation"->>'height')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 4096, false) END

chat_threads_shape_check.name: chat_threads_shape_check
chat_threads_shape_check.value: ("chat_threads"."type"::text = 'STREAM' AND "chat_threads"."stream" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_threads"."participant_a_membership_id" IS NULL AND "chat_threads"."participant_b_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_threads"."type"::text = 'DIRECT' AND "chat_threads"."stream" IS NULL AND "chat_threads"."participant_a_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_threads"."participant_b_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_threads"."participant_a_membership_id" < "chat_threads"."participant_b_membership_id")

encounters_mode_shape_check.name: encounters_mode_shape_check
encounters_mode_shape_check.value: ("encounters"."mode" = 'SCENE_REGION' AND "encounters"."target_scene_id" = "encounters"."source_scene_id" AND "encounters"."focus_region" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."location_id" IS NULL) OR ("encounters"."mode" = 'LINKED_SCENE' AND "encounters"."focus_region" IS NULL)

encounters_status_shape_check.name: encounters_status_shape_check
encounters_status_shape_check.value: ("encounters"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "encounters"."ended_by_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("encounters"."status" = 'ENDED' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."ended_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

player_likeness_consents_status_check.name: player_likeness_consents_status_check
player_likeness_consents_status_check.value: "player_likeness_consents"."status" IS NOT NULL AND (("player_likeness_consents"."status" = 'GRANTED' AND "player_likeness_consents"."granted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "player_likeness_consents"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("player_likeness_consents"."status" = 'REVOKED' AND "player_likeness_consents"."granted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "player_likeness_consents"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "player_likeness_consents"."revoked_at" >= "player_likeness_consents"."granted_at"))

player_requests_content_revision_check.name: player_requests_content_revision_check
player_requests_content_revision_check.value: length(trim("player_requests"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim("player_requests"."body")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND "player_requests"."revision" >= 0

player_requests_resolution_shape_check.name: player_requests_resolution_shape_check
player_requests_resolution_shape_check.value: (("player_requests"."status" IN ('RESOLVED', 'DECLINED')) AND "player_requests"."resolved_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR (("player_requests"."status" NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'DECLINED')) AND "player_requests"."resolved_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "player_requests"."resolution_note" IS NULL)

player_requests_cancellation_shape_check.name: player_requests_cancellation_shape_check
player_requests_cancellation_shape_check.value: ("player_requests"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "player_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("player_requests"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' AND "player_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

sticker_media_shape_check.name: sticker_media_shape_check
sticker_media_shape_check.value: "sticker_media"."size_bytes" > 0 AND "sticker_media"."size_bytes" <= 5242880 AND "sticker_media"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND "sticker_media"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND "sticker_media"."mime_type" IN ('image/png','image/webp') AND "sticker_media"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

sticker_packs_subject_shape_check.name: sticker_packs_subject_shape_check
sticker_packs_subject_shape_check.value: ("sticker_packs"."subject" = 'CHARACTER' AND "sticker_packs"."subject_character_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sticker_packs"."subject_membership_id" IS NULL AND "sticker_packs"."subject_label" IS NULL) OR ("sticker_packs"."subject" = 'PLAYER' AND "sticker_packs"."subject_character_id" IS NULL AND "sticker_packs"."subject_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sticker_packs"."subject_label" IS NULL) OR ("sticker_packs"."subject" IN ('NPC','CREATURE') AND "sticker_packs"."subject_character_id" IS NULL AND "sticker_packs"."subject_membership_id" IS NULL AND "sticker_packs"."subject_label" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("sticker_packs"."subject_label")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

sticker_packs_deprecation_check.name: sticker_packs_deprecation_check
sticker_packs_deprecation_check.value: "sticker_packs"."lifecycle" IS NOT NULL AND (("sticker_packs"."lifecycle" = 'DEPRECATED' AND "sticker_packs"."deprecated_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sticker_packs"."lifecycle" <> 'DEPRECATED' AND "sticker_packs"."deprecated_at" IS NULL))

stickers_provenance_check.name: stickers_provenance_check
stickers_provenance_check.value: "stickers"."provenance_type" IS NOT NULL AND length(coalesce("stickers"."source_reference", '')) <= 1000 AND length(coalesce("stickers"."author_credit", '')) <= 200 AND length(coalesce("stickers"."license_note", '')) <= 1000 AND ("stickers"."provenance_type" <> 'IMPORTED' OR ("stickers"."source_reference" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("stickers"."source_reference")) > 0 AND "stickers"."author_credit" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("stickers"."author_credit")) > 0 AND "stickers"."license_note" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("stickers"."license_note")) > 0))

story_import_sources_shape_check.name: story_import_sources_shape_check
story_import_sources_shape_check.value: length(trim("story_import_sources"."source_message_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim("story_import_sources"."source_author")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(coalesce("story_import_sources"."source_url", '')) <= 2048

story_post_media_shape_check.name: story_post_media_shape_check
story_post_media_shape_check.value: "story_post_media"."sort_order" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND length(trim("story_post_media"."alt_text")) BETWEEN 1 AND 240 AND length("story_post_media"."caption") <= 2000

story_posts_shape_check.name: story_posts_shape_check
story_posts_shape_check.value: length(trim("story_posts"."title")) <= 160 AND length("story_posts"."body") <= 20000 AND length("story_posts"."gm_notes") <= 10000 AND "story_posts"."revision" >= 0 AND (("story_posts"."lifecycle"::text = 'DRAFT' AND "story_posts"."visibility"::text = 'GM_ONLY' AND "story_posts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "story_posts"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("story_posts"."lifecycle"::text IN ('PUBLISHED','CORRECTED') AND "story_posts"."visibility"::text = 'PUBLIC' AND "story_posts"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "story_posts"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("story_posts"."lifecycle"::text = 'ARCHIVED' AND "story_posts"."visibility"::text = 'GM_ONLY' AND "story_posts"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)))

world_content_shape_check.name: world_content_shape_check
world_content_shape_check.value: length(trim("world_content"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("world_content"."summary") <= 2000 AND length("world_content"."public_text") <= 50000 AND length("world_content"."gm_only_text") <= 50000 AND "world_content"."revision" >= 0

world_content_instances_shape_check.name: world_content_instances_shape_check
world_content_instances_shape_check.value: ("world_content_instances"."display_name_override" IS NULL OR length(trim("world_content_instances"."display_name_override")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("world_content_instances"."current_state" IS NULL OR length("world_content_instances"."current_state") <= 4000) AND ("world_content_instances"."gm_notes" IS NULL OR length("world_content_instances"."gm_notes") <= 20000) AND ("world_content_instances"."condition" IS NULL OR length(trim("world_content_instances"."condition")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("world_content_instances"."quantity" IS NULL OR "world_content_instances"."quantity" >= 0) AND "world_content_instances"."revision" >= 0

world_content_media_shape_check.name: world_content_media_shape_check
world_content_media_shape_check.value: "world_content_media"."ordering" >= 0 AND ("world_content_media"."caption" IS NULL OR length(trim("world_content_media"."caption")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

world_map_locations_shape_check.name: world_map_locations_shape_check
world_map_locations_shape_check.value: length(trim("world_map_locations"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length("world_map_locations"."summary") <= 2000 AND length("world_map_locations"."gm_notes") <= 10000 AND "world_map_locations"."x" >= 0 AND "world_map_locations"."x" <= 1 AND "world_map_locations"."y" >= 0 AND "world_map_locations"."y" <= 1 AND "world_map_locations"."revision" >= 0

world_maps_background_approval_shape_che.name: world_maps_background_approval_shape_check
world_maps_background_approval_shape_che.value: ("world_maps"."background_asset_approved_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "world_maps"."background_asset_approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("world_maps"."background_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "world_maps"."background_asset_approved_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "world_maps"."background_asset_approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

world_maps_lifecycle_shape_check.name: world_maps_lifecycle_shape_check
world_maps_lifecycle_shape_check.value: ("world_maps"."lifecycle" = 'DRAFT' AND "world_maps"."published_at" IS NULL AND "world_maps"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("world_maps"."lifecycle" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "world_maps"."background_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "world_maps"."background_asset_approved_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "world_maps"."background_asset_approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "world_maps"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "world_maps"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("world_maps"."lifecycle" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "world_maps"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
